title: Replays of the verifiers of #207, #202, #197 and #199 (no new κ)
body:
I re-ran the verifiers of four open PRs from fresh clones at their current heads. #207 reproduces exactly, and so do #197 and the #199 diagnostic. #202's bit package passes, but its headline verifier doesn't reproduce here, because of a single environment-sensitive hash. No new κ, and nothing changes outside the new folder `research/independent-reproduction-20261009/`.

| PR | Head | Verifier | Exit | Printed κ | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| #207 | `cd14825023b7` | `coordinated-crossover-pr200/verify.py` | 0 | 1366380910073/2·10^15 | reproduced |
| #202 | `8d8d67bcf69c` | `paired-cube-diagonal-bit-168/verify.py` | 0 | 166261725903847/2.5·10^17 (package's own κ) | reproduced |
| #202 | `8d8d67bcf69c` | `source-assisted-v4/verify.py` | non-zero | none | not reproduced |
| #197 | `8c5e1cf07c23` | `packed-source-assisted-bit/verify.py … --full` | 0 | 135216063303877/2·10^17 | reproduced |
| #199 | `5c1fb8346615` | `bit_reuse_maximal.py` | 0 | diagnostic, output = committed | reproduced |

All runs: Linux x86_64 (WSL2, Ubuntu 24.04.5), CPython 3.13.16, numpy 2.3.5, scipy 1.17.0, fresh clones of `pull/<n>/head`, unmodified sources, `python -B`. One control run used CPython 3.12.3. Heads re-read at 18:05Z today, unchanged.

For #202, `source-assisted-v4/verify.py` stops with `Canonical certificate does not reproduce`. The 7 leaves that differ all derive from one value: the hash of the gzipped complex lift certificate, written by `exact_complex_flow_lift.py:409` (`gzip.compress(..., compresslevel=9, mtime=0)`). κ = 6768823/10^10 and every other leaf match. The lift I build is byte-identical to the one #194 committed, and #202 is #194 plus one commit (`8d8d67b`). #194's CI passed this same check under CPython 3.13.16, numpy 2.3.5 and scipy 1.17.0 (run 37931952877), which is my setup. #202's CI hasn't run: the PR has a merge conflict, and GitHub doesn't run `pull_request` workflows in that state, although `source-assisted-v4.yml` would run the same check. #194's check also fails here under CPython 3.12.3, so this check depends on the environment (interpreter or zlib build). I haven't isolated the cause and this isn't a defect claim. Recording the reference environment, or comparing the lift through its content as #207's `verify_inner.py:23,29-30` already does, would avoid it.

For #197, the full regeneration exits 0, prints the claimed κ and leaves the tree clean. The removal of the 6,600 rank-60 exterior children rests on the paper proof of `PROOF.md` §4 (lines 81-93), an identity on arbitrary bank contents; the finite controls of lines 95-98 support it but don't simulate the full cover. The maintainer review of the comparable removal for #186 is `research/community-round8-audit/BANK-SCHEDULE.md` on main. I didn't check that #197's banks match that schedule. #205 removes the same children and #207 cites #197 for its bootstrap; I didn't assess whether their own bank checks cover this.

Not done: #205, #206, #208 and #199's new composition files weren't replayed, and no `make verify` ran, since the PR adds only Markdown, JSON and a standalone script. These are finite replays, not a formal verification: the conditional interfaces stay as each PR states them.

I did this with help from Claude (Anthropic) agents; the runs were done locally.
